```{r}
#|echo: false
#|warning: false

# read in required packages
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(forcats)
library(scales)
library(ggsci)
library(viridis)
library(Microsoft365R)

source('config_sharepoint_location.R')

# params
reporting_quarter <- params$reporting_quarter
master_files_folder <- params$master_files_folder
quarter_string <- params$quarter_string

# go into share point and download latest data
master_files_dr <- chosenlib$get_item(glue::glue("{base_url}/{master_files_folder}"))

mat_neo_data_file <- master_files_dr$list_files() |> 
  select(name) |> 
  # need a better string
  filter(str_detect(name, 
                    # below is generated in read_qart_submissions.R
                    quarter_string)
         ) |>
  as.vector() |>
  unlist() |> 
  unname()

mat_neo_identified_data <- master_files_dr$get_item(str_glue({mat_neo_data_file}))

mat_neo_identified_data$download(dest = here("data", str_glue({mat_neo_data_file})), 
                       overwrite = T)

mat_neo_data <- read.csv(here(str_glue('data/{mat_neo_data_file}'))) |>
  mutate(latest_psc_name = str_remove_all(latest_psc_name, 'HIN'))
```

```{r}
# functions

# 1 aggregate by psc and intervention stage
aggregate_int <- function(df, my_filter, intervention) {
  # to quote variable
  intervention <- enquo(intervention)

  df |>
    filter(!!my_filter) |>
    group_by(
      latest_psc_name,
      !!intervention
    ) |>
    summarise(n = n()) |>
    ungroup() |>
    group_by(latest_psc_name) |>
    mutate(
      total = sum(n),
      percentage = n / total
    ) |>
    ungroup()
}

# 2 aggregate by quarter and calculate how many NHS orgs are reporting at a custom stage for a given intervention
aggregate_stage <- function(df, intervention, stage = "Stage 7") {
  # to quote variable
  intervention <- enquo(intervention)

  # to quote intervention name
  intervention_string <- deparse(intervention)

  intervention_name <- intervention_string |>
    str_remove("~") |> # 1 remove ~ added by deparse
    str_replace_all("_", " ") |> # 2 replace _ with blank space
    str_to_title() # 3 capitalise clean string into title

  df |>
    select(latest_psc_name:quarter, !!intervention) |>
    mutate(
      stage_x_or_above = str_count(!!intervention, stage)
    ) |>
    summarise(
      stage_x_all = sum(stage_x_or_above, na.rm = T),
      all_reporters = n(),
      percentage = (stage_x_all / all_reporters),
      .by = quarter
    ) |>
    mutate(
      intervention = intervention_name,
      .after = quarter
     )
}

# 3 make graph
visualise_bars <- function(df, intervention,
                           intervention_name = NULL,
                           # most plots will have latest_psc_name in their x axis, but some will need quarter instead
                           aes_x = expr(latest_psc_name),
                           # mopst plots will use the title below, except the quarter charts
                           plot_title = "Percentage of NHS Trusts at each implementation stage, by PSC",
                           plot_caption = glue::glue("Data reported by the PSC's for {reporting_quarter}")) {
  # to quote variable
  intervention <- enquo(intervention)

  # this is to set the subtitle string
  if (is.null(intervention_name)) {
    intervention_string <- deparse(intervention)

    intervention_subtitle <- intervention_string |>
      str_remove("~") |> # 1 remove ~ added by deparse
      str_replace_all("_", " ") |> # 2 replace _ with blank space
      str_to_title() # 3 capitalise clean string into title
  } else {
    intervention_subtitle <- intervention_name
  }

  # custom colour palette 
  my_viridis <- viridis(7)
  text_colour <- c(rep("white", 5), rep('black', 2))

  df |>
    ggplot(aes(
      x = forcats::fct_rev(!!aes_x), # reverse alphabetical order
      y = percentage,
      fill = forcats::fct_rev(!!intervention) # reverse stage order
    )) +
    geom_bar(
      stat = "identity",
      position = "stack",
      size = 11
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = my_viridis,
      na.value = "#808080",
      # below makes levels of factor appear in increasing order in legend (stage 1-7)
      guide = guide_legend(reverse = T)
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = text_colour, na.value = "white") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.025, 0.025)) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = scales::percent(percentage, accuracy = 1), # 1 means round to the nearest unit of 1, so 73.3 is rounded as 73 and no decimal places show on graph
        colour = forcats::fct_rev(!!intervention) # reverse again so position argument is obeyed
      ),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    ) +
    guides(
      colour = guide_none() # removes 'a' text from boxes in legend
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = intervention_subtitle,
      caption = plot_caption
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.justification = "left",
      plot.caption = element_text(
        face = "italic",
        size = 10,
        hjust = 0 # so caption is on right hand side
      )
    )
}

# 4 visualise line plots
visualise_line <- function(df, aes_group, aes_colour,
                           hline_colour, annotate_x, annotate_y, subtitle_string) {
  ggplot(
    data = df,
    aes(quarter,
      percentage,
      group = !!aes_group,
      colour = !!aes_colour
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0.65,
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = hline_colour
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format(),
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      x = annotate_x,
      y = annotate_y,
      label = "Target for FY 2024/25 (i.e., 65%)"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Adoption of optimisation interventions across NHS Trusts",
      subtitle = subtitle_string,
      caption = glue::glue("Data reported by the PSC's for {reporting_quarter}")
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        face = "italic",
        size = 10,
        hjust = 0 # so caption is on right hand side
      ),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.justification = "left"
    )
}
```

```{r}
mat_neo_long <- mat_neo_data |>
  select(-c(organisation_as_recorded, retroactive_fix, retroactive_correction)) |>
  filter(quarter == reporting_quarter) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = magnesium_sulphate:mews,
    names_to = "intervention",
    values_to = "stage"
  )

aggregate_int(
  mat_neo_long,
  my_filter = expr(!intervention %in% c(
    "mews", "newtt2" # excluded because they're not optimisation interventions
  )),
  stage
) |>
  visualise_bars(
    stage,
    "All optimisation interventions"
  )
```

##  

```{r}
#stage to use as benchmark progress
stage <- "Stage 7"

mat_neo_agg_stage_provider <- mat_neo_data |>
  select(latest_psc_name:volume_targeted_ventilation) |>
  mutate(
    all_stages = paste(magnesium_sulphate,
      corticosteroids,
      antibiotics,
      optimal_cord_management,
      normothermia,
      maternal_breast_milk,
      place_of_birth,
      caffeine, # not incorporated before project take over
      volume_targeted_ventilation, #ditto
      sep = " / "
    ), # will paste NA as string 'NA' and this is intentional for counts
    stage_x = str_count(all_stages, stage),
    stage_x_all = if_else(stage_x == 7, 1, 0)
  ) |>
  select(-all_stages)

mat_neo_stage_all <- mat_neo_agg_stage_provider |>
  group_by(quarter) |>
  summarise(
    stage_x_all_quarter = sum(stage_x_all),
    all_reporters = n(),
    percentage = (stage_x_all_quarter / all_reporters)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

visualise_line(
  df = mat_neo_stage_all,
  aes_group = expr(1),
  aes_colour = expr(NULL),
  hline_colour = "navy",
  annotate_x = "2023/24 Q4",
  annotate_y = 0.70,
  subtitle_string = "Percentage of organisations reporting implementation of all 9 optimisation interventions at stage 7"
) +
  geom_line(colour = "#660066") +
  geom_point(
    colour = "#660066",
    size = 2
  )
```

```{r}
spaghetti_data <- bind_rows(
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, magnesium_sulphate),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, corticosteroids),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, antibiotics),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, optimal_cord_management),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, normothermia),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, maternal_breast_milk),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, place_of_birth),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, caffeine), # not incorporated before project take over
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, volume_targeted_ventilation) # ditto
)

visualise_line(
  df = spaghetti_data,
  aes_group = expr(intervention),
  aes_colour = expr(intervention),
  hline_colour = "black",
  annotate_x = "2023/24 Q4",
  annotate_y = 0.8,
  subtitle_string = "Percentage of organisations reporting all implementation stages at level 7, by intervention"
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  ggsci::scale_colour_jco()
```

##  

```{r}
mat_neo_agg_newtt2_quarter <- mat_neo_data |>
  select(quarter, organisation_after_cleanse, newtt2) |>
  mutate(newtt2 = na_if(newtt2, "N/A")) |> 
  filter(!quarter %in% c('2021/22 Q1', '2021/22 Q2', 
                      '2021/22 Q3', '2021/22 Q4')
         ) |> # excludes quarters that have no records for this measure 
  group_by(quarter, newtt2) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(quarter) |>
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    percentage = (n / total)
  ) |>
  ungroup() 

# why do we have a plot by quarter only for NEWTT2 and MEWS ?
visualise_bars(
  df = mat_neo_agg_newtt2_quarter,
  intervention = newtt2,
  intervention_name = "Share of implementation stages across organisations",
  aes_x = expr(quarter),
  plot_title = "Adoption of NEWTT2 across NHS organisations",
  plot_caption = element_blank()
)
```
